episode.episode_description: Mistral AI has unveiled its latest model, Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion parameter beast nicknamed 'Le Chonk'. We look at what this massive scale means for the European AI landscape and why the real work begins when the weights drop later this month.

selected_story.headline: Mistral unveils 'Le Chonk', a 1T-parameter model
selected_story.source_title: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4, dubbed "le Chonk", a 1T-parameter open-weight model for general agentic capabilities, trained on 4,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs (Sabrina Ortiz/The Deep View)

short.title: Mistral unveils 'Le Chonk', a 1T-parameter model
short.description:
As a major European frontier lab, Mistral's move to provide a high-parameter model for agentic and cybersecurity tasks offers an alternative to the closed-model dominance of US-based labs.

short.script: Mistral unveils 'Le Chonk', a 1T-parameter model. Mistral AI has released a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion parameter multimodal model trained on 4,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
